empty.title: No projects yet
empty.description: Projects keep shared work, people and files together. Create one or wait for an invitation.

filtered.title: Nothing matches
filtered.description: No results for these filters. Counts only include items you can see.

error.title: Couldn’t load this page
error.description: Something went wrong on our side. Your changes are safe.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.description: Showing the last loaded version. Edits are paused until you reconnect.

unauthenticated.title: Sign in to continue
unauthenticated.description: Your session ended. Sign in again to open this project.

notAvailable.title: This project isn’t available
notAvailable.description: It may not exist, or you don’t have access. Ask the person who shared the link.

invite.title: You’re invited to “{project}”
invite.description: {inviter} invited you as {role}. Accept to see tasks and files. You need a verified account.

guest.title: Limited access
guest.description: You can see the {count} tasks shared with you. Other project content stays hidden.

revoked.title: Your access was removed
revoked.description: You’re no longer a member of this project. Cached content was cleared from this device.

archived.title: Archived · read-only
archived.description: This project was archived on {date}. You can view and export, not edit.

readOnly.title: View only
readOnly.description: Your role is Viewer. Ask an Admin if you need to edit.

conflict.title: This changed while you were editing
conflict.description: {person} moved “{task}” to {status}. Compare and choose which to keep.

deleted.title: This task was deleted
deleted.description: It was removed by a project Admin. It can’t be opened anymore.

pending.title: Pending approval
pending.description: Your change is waiting for a Manager to approve it.

quota.title: Limit reached
quota.description: Future only — no quota is enforced while all features are free.

teamNotAvailable.title: This team isn’t available
teamNotAvailable.description: It may not exist, or you’re not a member. Ask the person who shared the link.

teamInvite.title: You’re invited to “{team}”
teamInvite.description: {inviter} invited you as {role}. Joining the team does not give access to the team’s projects.

teamRemoved.title: Your access to this team was removed
teamRemoved.description: Team tasks left your Personal lists. Drafts kept on this device were discarded.

teamJoined.title: You joined the team
teamJoined.description: Joining a team gives team tasks, calendar, goals and files — never automatic access to every project.

companyNotAvailable.title: This company isn’t available
companyNotAvailable.description: It may not exist, or you’re not a member. Nothing from one company appears in another.

companyInvite.title: You’re invited to “{company}”
companyInvite.description: {inviter} invited you as {role}{department}. Accepting creates a work profile; your personal data is never shared.

companyLeft.title: You left this company
companyLeft.description: Company data disappears; your personal data stays yours. Expense claims you filed stay with the company.

companySealed.title: Employee file · sealed
companySealed.description: Every employee has a file; its contents need an explicit grant. Every open is audited and visible to the employee.

companyPolicy.title: Set by {company} · mandatory
companyPolicy.description: This control is enforced by the company: departments and people can’t override it.

companyOutside.title: Outside your department
companyOutside.description: Other departments are shown as names only — no people, budgets or files. Data beyond your scope is not listed.

companyAttachPending.title: Attach pending
companyAttachPending.description: Waiting for the owner’s consent to join the company. Until accepted nothing of it is visible to the company.

companyNotCounted.title: Not counted yet
companyNotCounted.description: Expenses count in budgets only after final approval; a reimbursement is “settled” only when Finance confirms the payment.

msgNotAvailable.title: Messages aren’t available yet
msgNotAvailable.description: Messaging needs a server that isn’t connected in this mode. Nothing here is simulated.

msgRemoved.title: You’re no longer in this conversation
msgRemoved.description: Its history, files and new messages aren’t available to you.

msgBlocked.title: You can’t message each other here
msgBlocked.description: Direct messages and presence are off between you. Shared groups still show their messages unless you collapse them.

msgReconnecting.title: Reconnecting…
msgReconnecting.description: Catching up from where you left off; nothing will be duplicated or reordered.

msgOffline.title: Offline · {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} will send when you’re back online
msgOffline.description: Mock mode: queued in this tab only.

msgPolicy.title: Set by {workspace}
msgPolicy.description: This rule comes from the workspace; channel admins can only make it stricter.

msgNotFound.title: Conversation not found
msgNotFound.description: It doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.

socialNotAvailable.title: This group isn’t available
socialNotAvailable.description: It may be private, deleted, or you were removed. Private groups can’t be found or counted.

socialRequested.title: Join requested
socialRequested.description: The admins of {group} approve or decline. Until then you see the public preview only.

socialGuest.title: Activity guest
socialGuest.description: You were invited to an activity of {group}. You see only that activity, its chat and your own expenses.

socialLeft.title: You left {group}
socialLeft.description: Access is revoked. Your own balance stays visible until it’s settled.

socialNotCounted.title: Not counted yet
socialNotCounted.description: Proposed expenses and pending edits are shown but don’t change any balance until approved.

socialBlocked.title: Blocked
socialBlocked.description: No connection requests or direct messages between you. Group rules still apply in shared groups.

socialOff.title: Sign in to use Social
socialOff.description: Social needs your signed-in account. Nothing from your other spaces is shown here.

banners.readOnly: You’re a Viewer in this project · editing is off
banners.guest: Limited access · you see {count} shared tasks only
banners.teamReadOnly: You’re a Viewer in this team · read only
banners.teamArchived: Team archived {date} · read-only · linked projects stay active
banners.companyReadOnly: You’re a Viewer in this company · read only

demo.label: Demo state
demo.hint: Mock data · demo states for review
